title: Actual system realization data for adic exceptional composition
statement:
For the actual coefficient categories and constructible adjunction systems of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients], and the canonical left compact-support compositors of [def-sf-exceptional-compositor-coefficient-data], define the following realization data. The coefficient scheme domain is the full subcategory of ordinary derived strict systems which satisfies the normalized finite-Tor predicate of [def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data] and the compatible-origin, common-cohomological-bound and common-Tor-bound predicate of [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. Evaluation is restriction of the actual derived evaluation to the finite-Tor constructible category. System compact support is the actual proper/open functor and graph-refinement compositor of [def-coef-system-compact-support-compositor].

A reconstruction datum on a scheme consists of the actual reduction/total-limit calculus, an equivalence between the integral constructible category and this system domain, equality of its functors after the full inclusions with reduction and total limit, and identification of its unit and counit with those of this calculus. A system operation datum consists of F, G, F adjoint to G, its actual proper/open support realization, its finite and integral left and right realization isomorphisms, and the finite and integral counit equations, as in [def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data].

For separated finite-type maps f:X to Y and g:Y to Z between separated finite-type schemes over the fixed finite-field datum, a compositor realization datum consists of three reconstruction data, system operation data for f, g and gf, and an isomorphism F_f followed by F_g to F_gf. Its left map is required to be exactly the proper/open graph-refinement compositor after the support realizations. Its finite and total-limit left realization equations identify it with the given canonical left compositors. The finite and total-limit right equations identify the conjugate of its inverse [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] with the specified finite and integral conjugates, as required by [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data]. Include the naturality equation of the actual reconstruction counit on this system conjugate.

A system scalar realization for E to L consists of a functor between these system domains whose ambient realization is the universal whole-sequence derived scalar extension of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], and whose total-limit realization is the specified completed scalar extension. A system coefficient comparison consists of left and right isomorphisms, the counit mate equation, and their total-limit left and right equations with the specified coefficient comparisons. Define the coefficient-square predicates on actual components, using the conjugates of the inverse left compositors. When two recorded restricted scalar functors share an endpoint, identify them by the unique isomorphism lifting their two actual ambient derived-scalar realizations through the fully faithful target inclusion. Ring equations cover integral reduction and completed extension; field equations cover raw rationalization, rational extension and common-finite-stage inclusion. These definitions assert no existence of any of the data. The operation functors, adjunction unit and counit, and finite evaluation identifications are the restrictions of r.F, r.G, r.adjunction, r.supportEvaluation and r.exceptionalEvaluation of [def-coef-finite-adjunction-system-data]. The support presentation uses the section-identity bridge and canonical adjunction-uniqueness maps of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Integral left realization is total limit of this support presentation, inverse reconstruction counit, then directIdentification of [def-sf-integral-compact-support-realization-map]; the integral right map is its counit-normalized mate. The scalar ambient identification is identity transport of equality of the actual functors; its limit comparison is inverse reconstruction counit followed by the normalized universal scalar realization of [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Consequently the system coefficient comparisons are the unique lifts of the prescribed integral q and b through the reconstruction equivalence, as expressed by leftLimit and rightLimit. In identifying finite left evaluations, use the canonical finite proper/open presentation [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data] between the ringed and intrinsic constant-coefficient support functors. The stage, coefficient-category, operation, scalar and comparison types, together with the rationalization and common-finite-stage functors, are those recorded in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]; the conjugate exceptionalIso of an inverse left compositor is the one of [def-sf-finite-exceptional-compositor-maps].
